checks.detail: No bypass or false ACK found in the edge. See newFindings.

newFindings: Known-email overwrite (source-read, not exercised live): installed Mautic SubmissionModel::createLeadFromSubmit (sha256 041db937...) resolves a submitted email to an existing contact and calls setFieldValues with overwriteWithBlank=false, so a public submission carrying a known contact's email overwrites that contact's non-blank firstname and adds a submission to it. The edge's 'contact 1 unchanged' proof only covers tracking-cookie association with a different email. Not tested live because it would modify existing contact data. Must be resolved or explicitly accepted before LIVE.

Ten unit survivors (runtime covers some): POST status!==200 check, errorMessage check, validationErrors check, email format check, firstname control-char check, read GET/HEAD method check, HEAD-returns-empty, exact form Content-Type, Content-Length precheck (stream cap still covers), CSP header (replay asserts CSP on actual edges). None is a bypass in current code; each can regress unnoticed by unit tests.
The DNT/Sec-GPC protection relies on pinned Mautic code (IpLookupHelper::isRequestTrackable, sha256 ddf67f36..., no config switch). A native image upgrade needs the read-effects check rerun.

public-a shares its internal network with db-a, bridge, mime-sink and authority (tenant-B edge only with web-b/db-b). The edge holds no credentials for them, but the network boundary is tenant-level, not edge-to-web only.
